attachments.origin_landmark: inferior border of the rib above, from tubercle to costochondral junction
attachments.insertion_landmark: superior border of the rib below

actions: elevate the ribs (primary inspiratory muscle of quiet and forced breathing)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population (11 spaces, repeating unit)
functional_compartments.function_note: Fibers run obliquely inferomedially (anterolaterally to posteromedially, 'hands in pockets' direction) from costochondral junction posteriorly to the rib angle, where the layer is replaced by the (thin) external intercostal membrane; consistently inspiratory across all 11 spaces per De Troyer et al.'s regional EMG studies.
functional_compartments.source: De Troyer A, Kirkwood PA, Wilson TA (2005) Physiol Rev 85(2):717-756 -- respiratory action and regional functional differences of the intercostal muscles

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); De Troyer A, Kirkwood PA, Wilson TA (2005) Physiol Rev 85(2):717-756 -- respiratory action and regional functional differences of the intercostal muscles
